summary: Barrel Energy, Inc. filed a Form 8-K on October 13, 2026, reporting under Item 8.01 that its Happy Traps subsidiary plans an October 2026 market launch of Almighty Cleaners, a line of eco-friendly cleaners and degreasers made from by-products recovered from collected used cooking oil and grease-trap waste. No financial terms, transaction consideration, advisor, or board recommendation are disclosed. No revenue projections were provided. This is a routine product-commercialization disclosure, not a special situation; watch execution risk around production capacity, recovered-material supply, and distribution.
